description: This file defines an abstract class BTreeDictionary for managing a dictionary using a B-tree data structure, including methods for adding, deleting, and querying words, as well as loading words from storage. It also contains nested classes for tree nodes and node arrays.

classes.name: BTreeDictionary
classes.description: An abstract class implementing a B-tree based dictionary with methods for managing words, including loading from storage, adding, deleting, and suggesting words.

classes.name: BTreeDictionary.WordReadListener
classes.description: Interface for callback when a word is read from storage, with a method to decide whether to continue reading.

classes.name: BTreeDictionary.Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the B-tree, containing a character code, frequency, terminal flag, and children nodes.

classes.name: BTreeDictionary.NodeArray
classes.description: A dynamic array of Node objects used to manage children of a node in the B-tree.

methods.name: createWordReadListener
methods.description: Creates a default WordReadListener that adds words to the in-memory structure if they are valid.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a word with a specified frequency to the dictionary, updating storage and in-memory structure.

methods.name: deleteWord
methods.description: Deletes a word from the dictionary and storage.

methods.name: getWordFrequency
methods.description: Returns the frequency of a given word in the dictionary.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Provides word suggestions based on input codes and a callback.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Checks if a word exists in the dictionary.

methods.name: loadAllResources
methods.description: Loads all words from storage into memory.

methods.name: closeAllResources
methods.description: Resets the dictionary and closes storage resources.

methods.name: resetDictionary
methods.description: Resets the in-memory root node array.
